'''Zeev Nehari''' (born '''Willi Weissbach'''; 2 February 1915 – 1978) was a [[mathematician]] who worked on Complex Analysis, Univalent Functions Theory, and Differential and Integral Equations. He was a student of [[Michael Fekete|Michael (Mihály) Fekete]]. The [[Nehari manifold]] is named after him.
